headline: Dominican Republic announces regional summit against illicit trade
summary: The Dominican government announced a regional summit to coordinate action against illicit trade, which Industry and Commerce Minister Eduardo Sanz Lovatón called a national security threat.
why: Illicit trade erodes tax revenue and legitimate business, so coordinated enforcement affects customs collection and the competitiveness of formal importers and producers.
original_headline: República Dominicana anuncia cumbre regional contra comercio ilícito
